references.text: God promises Moses that the people will serve Him on this mountain after their deliverance from Egypt
The same command to Pharaoh to let God's people go so they can serve Him
Moses and Aaron present the same message to Pharaoh: 'Let my people go, so they may hold a feast for Me'
Identical wording of the Lord's command to release the people in order to serve Him
Repetition of the same command in connection with the plague on livestock
The same command is repeated before the hail plague
The same message is presented before the locust plague
The purpose of the people being freed is to serve and worship the Lord
Contrasts Pharaoh's compromising offer with God's absolute demand for full service.
Reveals Pharaoh's misunderstood concept of 'service' in contrast to God's requirement.
Explains the theological reason for Pharaoh's refusal that meets the requirement in the source verse.
